# README image sources

The following assets come from Alexej Sailer's supplied **Agentic-Nets Articles**
collection:

| Asset | Source | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| `agentic-nets-three-layers.svg` | `00 Overview pictures/agentic-nets-three-layers.svg` | Adapted labels to Applications, Nets, and Platform; clarified retained history, guarded application actions, token reservations, and permission scope; added an accessible title and description. |
| `agentic-nets-article-pipeline-app.png` | `03 Applications of research-scout (2026-09-25)/screen size (first screen of each)/06 article-pipeline.png` | Original application screenshot, copied unchanged. |
| `agentic-nets-article-brief-net.png` | `01 New to Agentic-Nets (draft 946)/images/agentic-nets-net-article-brief-view.png` | Original diagram from the package's net definition with captured runtime status, copied unchanged. |

The example captures date from September 24–25, 2026. They illustrate that
installation at that time, rather than live counters or defaults on a fresh
installation. The three-layer diagram is an architectural overview.
